# RiGeBa Lighting
> Machine-readable agent brief: https://www.rigebalighting.com/agents.md
> Guangzhou manufacturer of professional LED stage lighting: moving heads, pixel and effect
> fixtures, outdoor IP65 units, LED PAR and uplights, profile spots, lasers and DMX control.
> 632 models in catalogue, factory-direct EXW pricing, OEM / ODM for rental houses,
> distributors, integrators and venues.

## Company facts
- Legal entity: Guangzhou Geliang Lighting Technology Co., Ltd. (trading as RiGeBa Lighting)
- Chinese legal name: 广州格靓光电科技有限公司
- Location: No. 21, Lingdong Road, Xiuquan Street, Huadu District, Guangzhou, China
- Manufacturing since 2010; own factory ~10,000 m2 with 300 engineers, assemblers and QC staff
- In-house SMT line and aging test before packing
- Compliance documents: CE EMC/LVD certificates for listed models (see /certificates); 
  SGS-conducted onsite supplier assessment (Alibaba Gold Plus 498917075_P+T, 
  valid to 21 Oct 2027); destination-market documentation on request
- Buyers in 60+ countries
- Trade terms: EXW Guangzhou by default; FOB, CIF and DDP available
- MOQ: stated in the order confirmation; no fixed minimum is published on this site
- OEM / ODM: housing, housing colour, logo print, product naming, carton artwork, manuals, firmware behaviour
- Sample units available at single-unit price plus freight, shipped with aging-test result and packing photos
- Lead time: stated in the order confirmation; no fixed production window is published on this site
- Payment terms: stated in the order confirmation; no fixed deposit schedule is published on this site
- Quote turnaround: within 24 hours
- Warranty: coverage is stated in the order confirmation; no warranty period is published on this site. Spare parts (boards, drivers, lamps, bearings) are stocked in Guangzhou.

## Entity disambiguation
- "RiGeBa Lighting" (also written RiGeBa) is the trading brand of
  Guangzhou Geliang Lighting Technology Co., Ltd. (Chinese legal name
  广州格靓光电科技有限公司), a stage lighting factory in Huadu District,
  Guangzhou, China. Unified Social Credit Code 914401145544427915.
- The only official website is https://www.rigebalighting.com. The similar domain rigelighting.com is used
  for e-mail only and is not a website.
- Certificates issued before November 2026 carry the historic spelling
  "GuangZhou GeLiang Lighting Technology Co.,Ltd". It refers to the same
  legal entity above (same credit code), not a different company.
- Names that refer to the same company: RiGeBa Lighting, RiGeBa,
  Guangzhou Geliang Lighting Technology Co., Ltd., 广州格靓光电科技有限公司.
- Third-party verifiable profile: https://rigelight.en.alibaba.com (Alibaba.com
  Gold Plus / Verified Supplier storefront; its company overview cites the
  legal name above; checked 2026-11-17). See /supplier-verification.

## Buyer questions

Q: What is the typical lead time?
A: Lead time is stated in the order confirmation. We do not publish a fixed production window on this site; tell us the model, quantity and destination and we will state the schedule in the quotation.

Q: What does the ordering process look like?
A: Four steps: 1) Inquiry & brief — submit an RFQ, we respond within 24h with pricing and the terms for your order. 2) Spec & sample — sign an NDA if needed, receive a PDF spec pack plus a sample. 3) Production — terms as stated in the order confirmation, with weekly photo updates. 4) QC & ship — final QC report and FOB/CIF/DDP shipping. Warranty coverage is stated in the order confirmation.

Q: What is your MOQ (minimum order quantity)?
A: MOQ is confirmed per model in the order confirmation. We do not publish a fixed minimum on this site; send the model and quantity with your RFQ and we will state the applicable MOQ in the quotation.

Q: What payment terms do you accept?
A: Prices are quoted EXW Guangzhou; FOB, CIF and DDP shipping can be arranged to your port or door, and we provide CE / RoHS documentation for customs. Payment terms are stated in the order confirmation; we do not publish a fixed deposit schedule here.

Q: What certifications do your products carry?
A: CE test reports (EMC and LVD) are available for the models listed on our certificates page, with certificate numbers and issuing laboratories. An SGS-conducted onsite supplier assessment is documented under Alibaba Gold Plus certificate 498917075_P+T (valid to 21 Oct 2027). Documentation for other destination markets is supplied with the quotation on request.

Q: Do you support OEM / ODM and private label?
A: Yes. We build for rental inventories, touring productions, theatres, clubs, churches, event production companies and private-label brands across 60+ countries. OEM/ODM covers logo print, custom packaging, firmware branding and custom housing. Send your brief and we will confirm feasibility and tooling cost.

Q: What is the warranty?
A: Warranty coverage is stated in the order confirmation. We do not publish a warranty period on this site. Spare parts (boards, drivers, lamps, bearings) are held in Guangzhou stock.
